Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi !

I couldn't read all the thread about siren's Lure so i have three simple
question.

I attempt to call a referendum with Siren#1. Interceptor#1 attempts to
block. Siren #2 plays Siren's Lure. Interceptor #2 attempts to block.
* At this point, can Siren#3 play another Siren's Lure ? If the answer is
yes, wich siren will enter combat right after the referendum ?
*Same situation as above, but Siren#1 is blocked and plays Change of target
after Siren#2 's Siren's Lure has been played. The action is cancelled, but
will Siren#2 enter combat with the previous wanna be blocker (Interceptor#1)
anyway ??
*Can Interceptor#1 play obedience to avoid combat with Siren#2 ?

reyda

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <a4dlfb$5o1$1...@hadron.noos.net>, Reyda <re...@noos.fr> writes:
>I attempt to call a referendum with Siren#1. Interceptor#1 attempts to
>block. Siren #2 plays Siren's Lure. Interceptor #2 attempts to block.
>* At this point, can Siren#3 play another Siren's Lure ?

No, you can't stack pending combats like that.

>If the answer is
>yes, wich siren will enter combat right after the referendum ?

Moot.

>*Same situation as above, but Siren#1 is blocked and plays Change of target
>after Siren#2 's Siren's Lure has been played. The action is cancelled, but
>will Siren#2 enter combat with the previous wanna be blocker (Interceptor#1)
>anyway ??

[LSJ 20011204]

http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3C0D0D63.CBF487FC%40white-
wolf.com&rnum=1

****

> The "cancel the action" phrasing makes me think that she's
> not under NRA restrictions, but since the action goes as far
> as being blocked, I'm not sure that that's correct.

She would be restricted by NRA.
"Canceled" doesn't mean "never happened". It's more like "irrevocably
terminated".

****

So it seems clear - since NRA would kick in - that the action has
resolved (rather than vanishing backwards), it's just completed in a
non-standard fashion. (NRA works on minions when the action resolves,
you see, per Mask of a Thousand Faces et al.)

So Siren's Lure would work.

>*Can Interceptor#1 play obedience to avoid combat with Siren#2 ?

No. Siren #2 is not an /acting/, younger vampire. (Card text.)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
> So it seems clear - since NRA would kick in - that the action has
> resolved (rather than vanishing backwards), it's just completed in a
> non-standard fashion. (NRA works on minions when the action resolves,
> you see, per Mask of a Thousand Faces et al.)

James's answers are all correct.
To elaborate/clarify the NRA rule: the NRA rule functions equivalently
to the following rule:

When an action resolves (is blocked or is successful), the acting minion
(at that time) receives a "Cannot preform <type>" NRA counter, where
<type> is the type of the action, as described in the V:EKN NRA rules. A
minion with such a counter cannot perform actions of type <type>. All NRA
counters on all minions are burned at the end of each turn.

(This handles ash-heap recycling, action canceling, etc. in the same
manner as the "real" NRA rule does)
